agentMessageTraceBlock.title: Agent Message Trace 1
agentMessageTraceBlock.description: A live execution waterfall with usage metrics, parallel agent branches, collapsed-span summaries, and popover details. Switch to the original resizable inspector for deeper debugging.
agentMessageTraceBlock.variantsBody: Use variant="live" for the real-time overview shown in the demo; omit variant for the original inspector workspace. Both reuse the same flat Span contract, safe tree model, virtualization, and controlled selection. This extends Agent Message Trace 1 instead of adding a separate block.
agentMessageTraceBlock.dataBody: Pass flat spans with stable ids, parentId relationships, relative timestamps, statuses and payloads. Optional usage records this span's own USD cost and input/output tokens. Parent rollups and trace totals are derived without double-counting. Supply nowOffsetMs for running spans; the host owns streaming and playback.
agentMessageTraceBlock.performanceBody: Rows use fixed-height virtualization, shared timeline grid lines, and controlled disclosure state. Filtering retains matching ancestors so the call path remains understandable.
